articles.title: Beyond extract_text: The Two Layers of a PDF That Drive RAG Quality
articles.reason: This article provides practical insights into improving RAG quality by leveraging both metadata and content layers in PDFs, which is directly relevant for building robust enterprise document intelligence workflows.
articles.summary: The article explains how understanding and utilizing both document-level signals (like metadata, native TOC, and source software) and page-level content (such as text, scans, tables, and layout) can significantly enhance the quality of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems. It highlights common pitfalls in PDF extraction and offers strategies to improve chunking and retrieval accuracy, which are critical for enterprise use cases. These insights are especially valuable for consultants designing RAG pipelines for regulated industries with complex document types.
actionable_insights: Audit current PDF ingestion pipelines to ensure both metadata and page-level content are being extracted and utilized.
